summarize_config: summarize the deformable detr refine config that enables box refinement on ResNet-50 backbone
review_model_update: review the model update that sets with_box_refine to True for deformable detr
run_deformable_detr_refine: run the deformable detr refine configuration with box refinement enabled on COCO dataset
build_deformable_detr_refine_config: build a training run using the deformable detr refine config with ResNet-50 and 50 epochs
test_box_refine: test the deformable detr model with box refinement enabled using the refine config
